evaluation.claim: Every physical law and every spiritual dynamic are two parameter regimes of one conserved master equation.
evaluation.compressed_claim: Every physical law and every spiritual dynamic are two parameter regimes of one conserved master equation.

channel_results.name: External input / dependency honesty
channel_results.reasoning: The claim depends on an external unified framework (master equation) which is speculative but not dishonest; it acknowledges dependency on a yet-unknown theory.

channel_results.name: Alignment / reference standard
channel_results.reasoning: No current reference standard supports a single master equation for both physics and spirituality; alignment is weak.

channel_results.name: Truth / signal fidelity
channel_results.reasoning: The claim lacks empirical signal; no evidence for a conserved equation bridging domains; fidelity is low.

channel_results.name: Entropy / disorder cost
channel_results.reasoning: The claim reduces entropy by unifying domains, but introduces complexity in defining 'spiritual dynamic'; moderate order.

channel_results.name: Temporal persistence
channel_results.reasoning: The idea of unification has persisted in various forms, but specific claim is not temporally stable; moderate persistence.

channel_results.name: Compression / wisdom density
channel_results.reasoning: The claim is highly compressible: one equation explains everything; high wisdom density if true.

channel_results.name: Phase transition / justified regime change
channel_results.reasoning: Would represent a phase transition in understanding, but justification is lacking; moderate.

channel_results.name: Free will / invitation vs coercion
channel_results.reasoning: The claim invites exploration and does not coerce belief; high free will compatibility.

channel_results.name: Cross-context binding
channel_results.reasoning: The claim attempts cross-context binding but fails to provide a concrete mechanism; weak binding.

channel_results.name: Integration / whole-system coherence
channel_results.reasoning: Partial integration: unifies but lacks specifics; moderate whole-system coherence.

evaluation.final_report: The claim is ambitious and compressible but lacks empirical support and cross-context binding. Coherence is moderate but degrades under evidence and falsification pressures.
